div.head: Abt 1[a]
div.ab: God’s property and the church’s [is to be compensated] with 12[-fold] compensation.
[Theft of] God’s property and the Church’s shall be compensated twelve fold;

The property of God and the Church [is to be paid for] with a twelve-fold compensation; a bishop’s property with an eleven-fold compensation; a priest’s property with a nine-fold compensation; a deacon’s property with a six-fold compensation; a cleric’s property with a three-fold compensation; the peace of the Church with a two-fold compensation; the peace of a meeting with a two-fold compensation.
Gottes und der Kirche Gut [entgelte der Dieb dem Bestohlenen] 12fach,
God’s and the Church’s property [let the thief repay to the one robbed] 12-fold,
div.note: Whitelock translates Abt 1 as one clause, which the sheet divides into rows 1[a], 1[b], 1[c], 1[d], 1[e], 1[f], 1[g]; her translation of the whole is given here, in the first row.
